description:

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
About Boon
 
 Boon is a wellness\\-first water purification brand. Tagline:
 **Water For Every You** 
 .
 



 Boon Homie is a connected purifier — commercial\\-grade filtration, mineral life modes (Daily, Active, Brew), and WaterAI, which makes performance visible and maintenance predictable. Purification you can trust. Enhancement you can feel. Proof you can see.
 



 The proof layer is software. Every filter\\-health reading, every smart alert, every "your cartridge has three weeks left" notification runs through the platform you'd be building.
 


 The Role
 
 You'll own backend services that connect thousands of purifiers in real homes to the Boon app and to our internal fleet tooling. Device telemetry in, intelligence out.
 



 This is a hands\\-on IC role with real ownership. You'll work across the seam where firmware meets cloud meets app — a place where the interesting problems live and where clean abstractions matter most.
 


 What You'll Do
 * Design, build, and run backend services that ingest, store, and act on high\\-volume device telemetry from a growing fleet
* Own device connectivity end to end: provisioning, secure onboarding, device shadows, command\\-and\\-control, and OTA update delivery
* Build the APIs powering the Boon mobile app — life modes, filter health, usage history, alerts, subscriptions, and service requests
* Turn raw sensor streams into the signals WaterAI needs for predictive maintenance and anomaly detection, in partnership with our data team
* Build internal fleet tooling so support and service teams can see device state, diagnose issues remotely, and act before a customer notices anything
* Integrate the commerce and ownership stack: filter replenishment, payments, warranty, CRM, and notification channels
* Instrument everything. Latency, delivery rates, dropped connections, alert accuracy — if we can't measure it, we can't promise it
* Work closely with firmware and mobile engineers to define protocols and contracts that hold up over years of field deployment
* Participate in on\\-call for the services you own, and write the runbooks that make on\\-call boring


 What You'll Bring
 
**Core** 



* 3–6 years building and operating production backend systems
* Strong in at least one of Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Go, or Java, and comfortable reading the others
* Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: queues, idempotency, retries, eventual consistency, backpressure
* Relational and NoSQL data modelling (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB or similar), plus caching with Redis
* API design that other teams enjoy consuming — REST or GraphQL, versioned thoughtfully



**IoT** 



* Hands\\-on with MQTT (or equivalent device protocols) and the realities of intermittent, low\\-bandwidth, unreliable connections
* Device lifecycle experience: provisioning, certificate\\-based auth, device twins/shadows, fleet grouping, OTA firmware rollouts
* Time\\-series telemetry at scale — ingestion, downsampling, retention strategy
* Understanding that a device in someone's kitchen behaves nothing like a service in a data centre



**AWS** 



* Production experience across a meaningful slice of: IoT Core, Lambda, ECS/EKS, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, Kinesis, Timestream, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK) and CI/CD pipelines you've actually maintained
* IAM least\\-privilege, secrets management, and cost awareness — you know what your architecture costs to run


 Nice to Have
 * Worked on a connected hardware product that shipped to consumers
* Wi\\-Fi/BLE device onboarding flows and the UX failure modes that come with them
* Edge compute, local buffering, or offline\\-first sync
* Supporting ML pipelines in production — feature stores, model serving, drift monitoring
* D2C stack integrations: Shopify, Razorpay, subscription billing, WhatsApp Business API, FCM/APNs
* Kafka or similar event streaming
* Early\\-stage experience where you set the standards rather than inherited them


 What Success Looks Like
 
**First 30 days** 
 — You've shipped to production, understand the device\\-to\\-cloud path end to end, and can explain how a single sensor reading becomes an alert in someone's hand.
 



**First 90 days** 
 — You own at least one core service outright. You've closed a reliability or latency gap that was bothering the team.
 



**First year** 
 — The fleet has grown severalfold and the platform absorbed it without drama. Your work is a reason people trust their Boon.
 


 How We Work
 * Small team, real ownership, short distance between an idea and a device in someone's home
* Hardware sets the pace. Firmware, app, and backend ship together, so we plan together
* We write things down. Design docs before big builds, runbooks after
* Proactive not reactive — we'd rather predict a failure than respond to one. That principle sits in the product, and it sits in how we run engineering


 Interview Process
 1. Intro call with the hiring manager (30 min)
2. Technical deep\\-dive on your past work (60 min)
3. System design — connected device platform (60 min)
4. Coding and problem solving (60 min)
5. Founder conversation (30 min)


* We aim to close the loop within two weeks.

description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C\\+\\+, Java, JavaScript).

* 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.


**Preferred qualifications:**

**About The Job**
 Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \\-\\- and as a manager, you guide the way.
   

  

 With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
   

  

 The AI and Infrastructure team works on the world’s toughest problems, redefining what’s possible and the possible easy. We empower Google customers by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Googler Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We’re at the center of amazing work at Google by being the “flywheel” that enables our advanced AI models, delivers computing power across global services, and offers platforms that developers use to build services.
   

  

 In AI and Infrastructure, we shape the future of hyperscale computing by inventing and creating world\\-leading future technology, and drive global impact by contributing to Google infrastructure, from software to hardware (including building Vertex AI for Google Cloud). We work on complex technologies at a global scale with key players in the AI and systems space. Join a team of talented individuals who not only work together to keep data centers operating efficiently but also create a legacy of driving innovation by building some of the most complex systems technologies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision\\-making across teams.
* Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching.
* Develop the mid\\-term technical vision and roadmap within the scope of your (often multiple) team(s). Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
* Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems.
* Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.
   

  

 Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.
   

  

 Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top\\-tier global investors, 60\\+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.
   

  

 Our platform helps pharmaceutical manufacturers digitize cleaning validation and monitoring, ensuring manufacturing equipment is cleaned correctly between production runs to prevent cross\\-contamination. Built for QA and Validation teams, every feature we ship is designed with accuracy, traceability, and regulatory compliance at its core.
